value.rationale: Euler characteristic curves are used in an established topological goodness-of-fit procedure and sample variance is a standard same-sample dispersion diagnostic. Exact joint dependence is required to combine or interpret these signals. The rank-resolved sign diagram explains how opposite local influences sum to a positive global covariance and identifies a sharp finite-sample 6..11 boundary, a meaningful nonseparable statistical structure not captured by marginal formulas.
